name: P.F Changs
desc:
Easy to use P.F. Changs GIFTCARDS :
1. first buy the Giftcard [ CALL THIS NUMBER TO CHECK BALANCE BEFORE YOU GO IN (877) 758-8965] [if they ask for pin or security number 0000] it’s a automated phone
2. Download Pass2U wallet from App Store or google store 
3. Enter the Pass2U app , bottom left corner press on “Pass Store” 
4. search up P.F. Changs , press on any of the templates 
5. add the Giftcard to it , then save it to your wallet 
6. Go in store and buy the food then show them the Giftcard to pay for it they gonna scan it and you should be good to go , you could also try to call and have it transferred into a physical Giftcard up to you ALSO YOU CAN GO IN AND HAVE IT TRANSFERED IN A PHYCIAL GIFTCARD AT THE STORE!!
